product.name: AI Agents for Logistics Industry
product.description: AI agents designed to automate and assist with repetitive logistics tasks such as carrier vetting, rate analysis, and carrier sales.

product.name: Broker-free Freight Shipping Platform
product.description: A subscription-based platform that enables businesses to book freight shipping directly with carriers, eliminating brokerage fees and automating logistics tasks.

product.name: Custom AI Agent Builder
product.description: A tool to create tailored AI agents that address specific logistics challenges and operational needs.

product.name: Carrier Vetting and Compliance Monitoring
product.description: A system that verifies carrier credentials, safety ratings, insurance, and compliance in real-time to ensure reliable and lawful freight transportation.

product.name: Integration with Logistics Tech Stack
product.description: Integration services that connect Arnata AI agents with logistics management systems, load boards, communication tools, and other software.

product.name: Automated Freight Management and Documentation
product.description: A service that automates freight billing, document collection, generation of bills of lading, invoices, and payment processing.
